meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，当你说出重构相关指令时，Claude 会先理解你的意图，然后分析整个代码库，评估风险，制定详细计划，再一步步执行重构，每一步都自动运行测试确保不出错。
howto.when: 当你提到“refactor”、“cleanup”、“restructure”等关键词，或要求重构代码时触发。

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类，改为 aggressive 策略
say.note: Claude 会用更激进的方式重构整个类。

say.text: 提取所有验证逻辑到独立模块并保持测试通过
say.note: Claude 会先分析依赖再逐步提取并验证。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will understand your refactoring intent, analyze the codebase, assess risk, plan meticulously, execute step-by-step with continuous test verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', 'restructure', or when you ask to refactor code.

say_en.text: Refactor AuthService class with aggressive strategy
say_en.note: Claude uses aggressive strategy for the class.

say_en.text: Extract all validation logic into separate module, keep tests passing
say_en.note: Claude analyzes dependencies then extracts step by step.
